tapeLine: Monday 2 November: S&P 500 -0.5% after erasing an early gain of 1.1%, Dow +0.4%, Nasdaq -1.1%, per AP-based reports dated 2 Nov. Index levels and Tuesday futures were not found.
matters:
AP-based coverage of Monday’s session said a morning rally petered out as tech and AI stocks stayed shaky after last week’s sell-off. Nearly seven in ten S&P 500 stocks rose, yet nearly every chip stock fell; Yahoo Finance said the group lost more than $400 billion of market value in one session, with Intel again the largest decliner and worth less than half its end-of-September value.

Alphabet rose as much as 2.6% early, then closed down 0.3%, after last week’s drop of more than 12%.

scorecard.text: The prior brief’s open question on whether Friday’s AI-spending sell-off extends was answered for chips: they fell again Monday, losing more than $400 billion of value per Yahoo Finance.
The prior brief’s read that Friday’s fall was a broad risk-off was too wide: on Monday the Dow rose 0.4% and about 7 in 10 S&P 500 stocks gained.
